newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Continental Air plans May Brazil flights.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air plans May Brazil flights.

text.p: U.S. carrier Continental Airlines Inc said it plans to begin daily flights to Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro from Newark beginning in May.
Continental, the fifth largest airline in the United States, said in a statement that it was still awaiting authorization from the Brazilian government, which it expects by May.
The airline would be the third U.S. passenger carrier to enter the Brazilian market, where UAL Corp's United Airlines and AMR Corp's American Airlines already operate.
Continental has also reached an agreement with the government to allow local travel agents to sell Continental tickets, the statement said.
